items.titleZh: 加州收紧人工智能数据中心能源和用水的规定
items.titleEn: California tightens rules on AI data center energy and water use
items.summaryZh: The Verge AI 报道了人工智能基础设施的发展情况。消息来源的要点：据《洛杉矶时报》早些时候报道，加州州长加文·纽瑟姆 (Gavin Newsom) 签署了七项法案，旨在防止人工智能数据中心将公用事业成本转嫁给居民。
items.summaryEn: The Verge AI reports an infrastructure development in AI. Key point from the source: California Gov. Gavin Newsom has signed seven bills designed to prevent AI data centers from passing utility costs onto residents, as reported earlier by the Los Angeles Times.
